//Description: This file controls the System Configuration Input Form (New-InputForm-JSONDriven.ps1)
//DomainSuffix: Default domain suffix displayed in the computer naming preview (optional)
//LogoFileName: Logo image file name (must be in same directory as script)
//SoftwareFromDeployR: Set to 'True' to retrieve software list dynamically from DeployR API, 'False' to use static Software list below
//OUs: List of Organizational Units available for domain join operations
//AutopilotGroupTags: Available Autopilot group tags for device registration
//Roles: User role options - DisplayName is shown in UI, Value is what gets stored/returned
//Software: Static software list (used when SoftwareFromDeployR is False or if DeployR retrieval fails) - DisplayName shown in UI, Id used for identification
